fields.label: Section notes
fields.hint: Introduction / Results / Discussion — jot what changes your reading.

fields.label: Virtual re-implementation
fields.hint: Rebuild it in your head under the authors' own assumptions: which step is underspecified, which choice did you have to make for them?

fields.label: Discrepancies
fields.hint: Numbers, figures or claims that don't line up.

fields.label: Controls & replicates
fields.hint: Computational: trace how main equations connect inputs to outputs. Wet lab: list exact controls needed vs controls actually in the figures.

fields.label: Discussion overclaims
fields.hint: Sentences that go beyond what the figures strictly prove.

fields.label: "What if?" stress test
fields.hint: Pick 2-3 fixed parameters, boundary conditions or reagents — what happens if you change them?

fields.label: Future work ideas
fields.hint: At least 1 testable follow-up that addresses a gap.

fields.label: Backfill (high-value only)
fields.hint: Only things missed in Pass 1/2 that change how you interpret results.

fields.label: How I'd present this
fields.hint: One-liner for lab meeting/notes, and the single figure that carries it.

checklist: Can I reconstruct the experimental/mathematical workflow from memory on a blank sheet?
Did I identify >2 implicit assumptions or variables that could change the conclusion?
1 testable follow-up hypothesis or experiment that addresses a gap?
todos: Re-derive the core logic / virtually re-implement (computational: trace equations input→output; wet lab: list the controls the claim needs)
Challenge every assumption in every statement
What-if: 2-3 fixed parameters, boundary conditions or reagents — what changes?
Separate data from interpretation in the Discussion
Note how you'd present it, plus follow-up ideas
